name: Fujii Takane
source:
A first year at Saint Angela Academy who is in the same class as Hisui. He's a problem child.

Although he used to be bright and friendly, he's now distrustful of others and anxious. His personality is dark and somewhat taciturn.

Hobby: Playing games at home

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160701090056/http://www.hanerom.dojin.com/p_fujii.html]official website[/url]]
